# scripts/

Helper scripts for building, linting, seeding, and releasing omnifocus-mcp.
Read this file before grepping scripts/ — the right script is often one line away.

## Build

### build-calendar-bridge.sh

Compile the Swift EventKit calendar-bridge binary (per ADR-0018).

```bash
bash scripts/build-calendar-bridge.sh
```

### build-watcher.sh

Compile the Swift FSEventStream watcher binary (universal fat binary).

```bash
bash scripts/build-watcher.sh
```

## Verify / lint

### check-automation-permission.sh

Verify the shell process has macOS Automation permission for OmniFocus.

```bash
bash scripts/check-automation-permission.sh
```

### check-bundle-size.sh

Enforce the dist/index.js bundle-size budget (< 820 KiB per DESIGN §20).

```bash
bash scripts/check-bundle-size.sh
```

### verify-constants.sh

Catch drift between _project-constants.sh and the live GitHub Project field IDs.

```bash
bash scripts/verify-constants.sh
```

### verify-intents.sh

Verify omnifocus://intents references only registered tools/prompts/resources.

```bash
bash scripts/verify-intents.sh
```

### verify-no-hosted-runners.sh

Fail if any workflow targets a GitHub-hosted runner outside the allowlist.

```bash
bash scripts/verify-no-hosted-runners.sh
```

### verify-no-tool-counts.sh

Fail if any living doc restates the count of registered MCP tools (per #478).

```bash
bash scripts/verify-no-tool-counts.sh
```

### lint-custom.ts

Custom lint runner — calls src/linting/customRules.ts over all source files.

```bash
pnpm run lint:custom  # or: tsx scripts/lint-custom.ts
```

### verify-nl-quality.ts

Enforce the NL-quality rubric over src/tools/ descriptions at lint time.

```bash
tsx scripts/verify-nl-quality.ts
```

### validate-deps.sh

Audit the 'Blocked by: #N' dependency graph for cycles and orphan references.

```bash
bash scripts/validate-deps.sh
```

## Generate / docs

### generate-tool-docs.ts

Generate docs/tools.md — full parameter reference for every MCP tool.

```bash
pnpm run docs:generate  # or: tsx scripts/generate-tool-docs.ts
```

### extract-changelog-section.sh

Print a single CHANGELOG.md section body for use in GitHub Release notes.

```bash
bash scripts/extract-changelog-section.sh 1.2.3
```

## Project / tracker

### file-issue.sh

Atomically create a GitHub issue and wire it into project #4 with all fields.

```bash
bash scripts/file-issue.sh --title '...' --labels '...' --status 'Up Next'
```

### set-ready-status.sh

Set Status=Up Next on unblocked issues and Backlog on blocked ones.

```bash
bash scripts/set-ready-status.sh
```

### populate-project.sh

Add all issues to the v1 project board and set Phase/Priority/Size/Risk fields.

```bash
bash scripts/populate-project.sh
```

## Release

### update-homebrew-formula.sh

Update the omnifocus-mcp Homebrew formula in torsday/homebrew-tap after publish.

```bash
bash scripts/update-homebrew-formula.sh <version>
```

## Integration / seeding

### seed-integration-db.js

Seed mcp-fixture: prefixed items into a live OmniFocus for integration tests.

```bash
node scripts/seed-integration-db.js [--clean]
```

### clean-integration-db.js

Delete every mcp-fixture* item from a live OmniFocus (no re-seed). Safety net for killed suites that skip afterAll teardown; runs as test:integration's posttest hook and the CI if:always() cleanup step.

```bash
node scripts/clean-integration-db.js [--dry-run]
```
